_help: Projects shown on every edition, in this order.
Give "repo": "owner/name" and the site fetches name, description, tags (GitHub topics), language, year and website from GitHub.
Any field you write by hand wins over GitHub: name, description, tags, tech, year, url, homepage.
Without "repo", write the fields yourself (name, description and url at least).
Repos that don't belong to eierman324 are shown as "owner/name".
"group" must be one of the ids under "groups".
